release_notes: Test release of mwongj/VOD2MLIB PR #5. Active movie and series filters now archive confirmed rejected NFO-only title folders, including legacy and Emby-written metadata, outside output roots with a recovery manifest. Works after unfiltered generation or STRM-only cleanup, even when NFO generation is disabled. Remaining STRMs, symlinks, unrelated files, passing sources and unresolved identities protect folders. Preview models planned removals and reports matching archive candidates; results and telemetry report archive counts, protections and errors. NFO controls are grouped under a heading and description explaining Emby ownership checks versus metadata writing. Saved settings and defaults are preserved. README and changelog updated. Validation: 442 Linux tests passed; Python 3.10 and 3.12 CI passed; real Dispatcharr ORM validation against 50,568 relations using temporary output/state created zero episodes and preserved saved settings. No Dispatcharr source changes. Upgrade to this RC to test Generate Movies or Generate Series with current saved filters; scan Emby after cleanup. Archived NFO metadata is retained under /data/vod2mlib/filtered-nfo (or the configured state directory).
